title: What paper bag details are needed before requesting a quote? - MUGE PACKAGING SourceBridge
company: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
buyer_question: What paper bag details are needed before requesting a quote?
buyer_context: retail paper bags, boutique shopping bags, event bags and brand packaging programs
short_answer: A quote-ready brief should give the supplier enough context to review structure, material, print and packing direction before pricing. For printed paper bags, MUGE PACKAGING recommends sending bag size and use case, paper and handle direction, print coverage, finish reference, packing method and target market, plus artwork status and the target market.
